mapper.select: /* selectMasterMpIfOrderQuantityDivsnList */ SELECT DECODE(MAX((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND LEGACY_PO_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ)),0 , '신규', '수정') AS STATUS, A.LEGACY_PO_NO, /* 요청번호*/ A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, /* 항번 */ A.REF_IF_NO, /* 관리번호 */ A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, /* 품목코드 */ A.ITEM_QTY, /* 요청수량 */ A.ADD_DATE, /* 등록일 */ A.RD_DATE, /* 요구일 */ COUNT(B.AGENT) AS AGNET_CNT, /* 공급사계 */ A.ERROR_MSG, /* 에러내용 */ A.BUYER, '' AS YEAR, SUM(B.ITEM_QTY) AS DIVIDE_ITEM_QTY FROM IF_PODT A, POIFLOAD_DAEW B WHERE A.BUYER = 'KRDAEW0016' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'S' AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE(+) AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = B.LEGACY_PO_NO(+) AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ(+) GROUP BY A.BUYER,A.LEGACY_PO_NO,A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,A.REF_IF_NO,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO,A.ITEM_QTY,A.ADD_DATE,A.RD_DATE,A.ERROR_MSG ORDER BY A.LEGACY_PO_NO,A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ

/* selectMasterMpIfOrderQuantityDivsnExcel */ SELECT MAX(DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND LEGACY_PO_NO = A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ),0,'신규','수정')) AS STATUS, /* 상태 */ MAX(A.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, /* 주문번호 */ MAX(A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, /* 주문순번 */ MAX(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, /* 품목코드 */ MAX(B.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, /* 품명 */ MAX(B.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, /* 규격 */ MAX(B.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE, /* 단위 */ MAX(B.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME, /* 제조사 */ MAX(A.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY, /* 주문수량 */ MAX(A.UNIT_PRICE) AS ORDER_UNIT_PRICE, /* 주문단가 */ MAX(B.UNIT_PRICE) AS SALE_UNIT_PRICE, /* 판매단가 */ MAX(A.REMARK) AS REMARK, /* 비고 */ TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(A.ADD_DATE)), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE, /* 주문일 */ TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(A.RD_DATE)), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RD_DATE /* 납기요구일 */ FROM IF_PODT A, ICOMCQDT B WHERE A.BUYER = 'KRDAEW0016' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'S' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO GROUP BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ ORDER BY LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
/* getMasterMpIfOrderQuantityDivsnBycaComorg */ SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{BUYER} GROUP BY BYCA_COMORG_CODE
/* getMasterMpIfOrderQuantityDivsnDelyToLocation */ SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{BUYER} AND CODE = #{DELY_TO_LOCATION} AND TYPE = 'C012'
/* getMasterMpIfOrderQuantityDivsnIcomprdtSeq */ SELECT PR_NO, COUNT(*) PR_SEQ FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER ='KRDAEW0016' AND LEGACY_PO_NO = #{LEGACY_PO_NO} GROUP BY PR_NO
/* getMasterMpIfOrderQuantityDivsnOrderNo */ SELECT DOC_TYPE||SUBSTR(YEAR,3,2)||LPAD(CUR_NO,6,0) AS ORDER_NO FROM ICOMSQMT WHERE COMPANY = #{COMPANY} AND DOC_TYPE = #{DOC_TYPE}
mapper.update: /* insertMasterMpIfOrderQuantityDivsnIcomprdt */ INSERT INTO ICOMPRDT ( BUYER, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SELLER_ITEM_NO, SELLER, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, CUR, RD_DATE, TARGET_QTY, TARGET_PRICE, MAKER_CODE, MAKER_NAME, MAKER_PART_NO, DELY_TO_LOCATION, PURCHASER_DEPT, ADD_USER_ID, ADD_USER_NAME, ADD_USER_TEL, ADD_USER_DEPT, CHANGE_USER_ID, CHANGE_USER_NAME, CHANGE_USER_TEL, CHANGE_USER_DEPT, CATALOG_ITEM_NO, ITEM_TYPE, ACCOUNT_TYPE, PURCHASING_AGENT_FLAG, RECV_FLAG, REF_PR_NO, REF_ADD_USER_ID, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_DEPT, SAVE_FLAG, PO_QTY, AGENT, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, REMARK, LIST_PRICE, DOC_TYPE, REQ_USER_INFO, REF_IF_NO, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PROCESS_TYPE, REF_NO, REF_SEQ, RECV_QTY, CATEG_ID, PURCHASER_ID, CMS_CATEG_ID, CMS_CATLG_ID, ITEM_GROUP ) VALUES ( #{BUYER}, #{PR_NO}, TO_CHAR(#{PR_SEQ},'FM000000'), 'C', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}, #{SELLER_ITEM_NO}, 'KRKORE0001', #{DESCRIPTION}, #{SPECIFICATION}, #{UNIT_MEASURE}, #{CURRENCY_CODE}, #{RD_DATE}, #{ITEM_QTY}, #{UNIT_PRICE}, #{MAKER_CODE}, #{MAKER_NAME}, NVL(#{MAKER_PART_NO},''), NVL(#{DELY_TO_LOCATION}, ' '), #{DEPARTMENT}, #{PURCHASER_USER_ID}, #{USER_NAME_LOC}, #{PHONE_NUMBER}, #{DEPARTMENT}, #{PURCHASER_USER_ID}, #{USER_NAME_LOC}, #{PHONE_NUMBER}, #{DEPARTMENT}, '', 'BC', 'M', 'Y', 'PC', #{LEGACY_PO_NO}, #{PURCHASER_USER_ID}, DECODE(NVL(#{REQ_USER_ID},' '),' ',NVL(#{PURCHASER_USER_ID},' ')), #{DEPARTMENT}, 'PX', #{ITEM_QTY}, #{AGENT}, #{CONTRACT_NO}, #{CONTRACT_SEQ}, #{LEGACY_PO_NO}, #{LEGACY_PO_SEQ}, #{REMARK}, #{LIST_PRICE}, NVL(#{DOC_TYPE},'N'), #{REQ_USER_INFO}, #{REF_IF_NO}, #{BYIT_COMORG_CODE}, #{PROCESS_TYPE}, #{PX_NO}, TO_CHAR(#{PR_SEQ},'FM000000'), #{ITEM_QTY}, #{CATEGORY_NO}, #{PURCHASER_USER_ID}, #{CMS_CATEG_ID}, #{CMS_CATLG_ID}, #{ITEM_GROUP} )

INSERT INTO ICOMPRHD ( BUYER, PR_NO, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, NOTIFY, PR_SUBJECT, PURCHASER_DEPT, ADD_USER_ID, ADD_USER_NAME, ADD_USER_TEL, ADD_USER_DEPT, CHANGE_USER_ID, CHANGE_USER_NAME, CHANGE_USER_TEL, CHANGE_USER_DEPT, RECV_FLAG, ACCOUNT_TYPE, DELY_TO_LOCATION, SAVE_FLAG ) ( SELECT BUYER, PR_NO, 'C', ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, BUYER, SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_SINGLE_BYTE(RTRIM(DESCRIPTION )),' '),1,40), PURCHASER_DEPT, ADD_USER_ID, ADD_USER_NAME, ADD_USER_TEL, ADD_USER_DEPT, CHANGE_USER_ID, CHANGE_USER_NAME , CHANGE_USER_TEL, CHANGE_USER_DEPT, 'GA', ACCOUNT_TYPE, (SELECT MAX(TEXT2) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = BUYER AND TYPE='C012' AND CODE = DELY_TO_LOCATION) DELY_TO_LOCATION , SAVE_FLAG FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PR_NO = #{PR_NO} AND PR_SEQ = TO_CHAR(#{PR_SEQ},'FM000000') )

/* insertMasterMpIfOrderQuantityDivsnIcompodt */ INSERT INTO ICOMPODT ( BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, SELLER, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, BUYER_ITEM_NO, SELLER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, ITEM_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, ITEM_AMT, RD_DATE, MAKER_CODE, MAKER_NAME, DOM_EXP_FLAG, DELY_TO_LOCATION, COMPLETE_MARK, PR_NO, PR_SEQ, REF_PR_NO, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, PROXY_BUY_FLAG, AGENT_PRICE, AGENT_ITEM_AMT, CHANGE_USER_DEPT, LEGACY_PO_NO, CHANGE_USER_ID, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, REF_IF_NO, DS_FLAG, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PROCESS_TYPE, WAREHOUSE_CODE, CATEG_ID, PO_REMARK, CMS_CATEG_ID, CMS_CATLG_ID, ITEM_GROUP, KEP_PRICE, ST_DATE, DELIVERY_LT ) VALUES ( #{BUYER}, #{PO_NO}, TO_CHAR(#{PO_SEQ},'FM000000'), #{SELLER}, #{STATUS}, #{ADD_DATE}, #{ADD_TIME}, #{CHANGE_DATE}, #{CHANGE_TIME}, #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}, #{SELLER_ITEM_NO}, #{DESCRIPTION}, #{SPECIFICATION}, #{UNIT_MEASURE}, #{ITEM_QTY}, #{UNIT_PRICE}, #{ITEM_AMT}, #{RD_DATE}, #{MAKER_CODE}, #{MAKER_NAME}, #{DOM_EXP_FLAG}, #{DELY_TO_LOCATION}, #{COMPLETE_MARK}, #{PR_NO}, #{PR_SEQ}, #{REF_PR_NO}, #{CONTRACT_NO}, #{CONTRACT_SEQ}, #{PROXY_BUY_FLAG}, #{AGENT_PRICE}, #{AGENT_ITEM_AMT}, #{CHANGE_USER_DEPT}, #{LEGACY_PO_NO}, #{CHANGE_USER_ID}, #{LEGACY_PO_SEQ}, #{REF_IF_NO}, #{DS_FLAG}, #{BYIT_COMORG_CODE}, #{PROCESS_TYPE}, #{WAREHOUSE_CODE}, #{CATEG_ID}, #{REMARK}, #{CMS_CATEG_ID}, #{CMS_CATLG_ID}, #{ITEM_GROUP}, #{KEP_PRICE}, F_GET_DELIVERY_INFO(#{BUYER}, #{CONTRACT_NO}, #{CONTRACT_SEQ}, #{RD_DATE}, 'D'), NVL((SELECT DELIVERY_LT FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BELOW_COMORG_CODE = #{BUYER} AND CONTRACT_NO = #{CONTRACT_NO} AND CONTRACT_SEQ = #{CONTRACT_SEQ} AND STATUS != 'D'), 15) )

INSERT INTO ICOMPOHD ( BUYER, PO_NO, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, PO_CREATE_DATE, BUYER_GROUP, AGENT, PAYER, NOTIFY, SELLER, PAYEE, PAY_TERMS, USANCE_DAYS, DELY_TERMS, CUR, PO_TTL_AMT, PO_TAX_TTL_AMT, PURCHASER_ID, PURCHASER_NAME, PROCESS_TYPE, ACCOUNT_TYPE, SHIPPER_TYPE, PO_REMARK, VERSION, EMAIL_FLAG, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_USER_ID, DELY_TO_LOCATION, CHANGE_USER_DEPT, PR_TYPE, AGENT_PO_TTL_AMT, LEGACY_AGENT_CODE, PO_SUBJECT ) ( SELECT MAX(D.BUYER), MAX(E.PO_NO), 'C', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), MAX(D.ADD_DATE), MAX(D.BUYER), MAX(C.AGENT), MAX(D.BUYER), MAX(D.BUYER), MAX(D.SELLER), MAX(D.SELLER), 'AP', 0, 'OST', 'KRW', SUM(D.TARGET_PRICE * D.TARGET_QTY), SUM(D.TARGET_PRICE * D.TARGET_QTY), MAX(D.ADD_USER_ID), MAX(D.ADD_USER_NAME), MAX(E.PROCESS_TYPE), 'M', ' ', MAX(TRIM(D.REQ_USER_INFO||' 발주번호:' || D.LEGACY_PO_NO)), '1', 'N', MAX(D.ADD_USER_ID), MAX(D.ADD_USER_ID), MAX((SELECT DELY_TO_LOCATION FROM ICOMPRHD WHERE BUYER = D.BUYER AND PR_NO = D.PR_NO)), MAX(D.ADD_USER_DEPT), 'PX', SUM(C.LIST_PRICE * D.TARGET_QTY), ' ', SUBSTRB(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(MAX(D.DESCRIPTION),'\"',' '),'''',' '),'#',' '),1,40) FROM ICOMCQDT C, ICOMPRDT D, ICOMPODT E WHERE E.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND E.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND E.LEGACY_PO_NO = #{LEGACY_PO_NO} AND E.BUYER = D.BUYER AND E.PR_NO = D.PR_NO AND E.PR_SEQ = D.PR_SEQ AND D.RECV_FLAG = 'PC' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND E.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND E.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND E.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND E.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND C.INFO_CREATE_FLAG = 'N' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.AGENT = C.AGENT )
